title: AIM BREAKS A SPRINT
why: His order 10-20: aiming should immediately break sprint, even if Shift is still held. The old rule dropped aim while sprinting; now aim wins, and the sprint returns when aim is let go.
now: Aiming stops a sprint at once and holds with Shift down; let go of aim and the sprint comes back.

edits.replacement: // v28.xx (cw-adsbreaks), HIS ORDER 2026-10-20: "ADS should immediately break sprint, even if shift is still held down". The v16.81 drop of aim under a held sprint is gone: aim wins, the sprint is cut by the p.ads test below, and it comes back by itself when aim lets go with Shift still down.
